UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user profile and Firebase email verification state

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID

emailVerified.description: Whether Firebase Auth verified the user email

displayName.description: Display name shown in the UI

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest profile sync

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Owner-scoped UI and non-secret AI provider preferences

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

parkedVehicle.description: Native parked vehicle location pin and notes stored on user preferences

mapsPlacesJson.description: Deprecated legacy JSON field kept only for one-time migration into savedPlaces subcollection

mapsParkingJson.description: Deprecated legacy JSON field kept only for one-time migration into native parkedVehicle

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were updated

SavedPlace.title: SavedPlace
SavedPlace.description: Owner-scoped saved everyday location (Casa, Institut, Work, Favorite) stored natively under the user profile

id.description: Document ID matching the savedPlaces document key

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner

role.description: Semantic role of the saved location

category.description: Category label shown in the Saved Places UI

address.description: Formatted street address or coordinates label

savedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds timestamp of last user update

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when place was first created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when place was last updated

/users/{userId}.description: User profile document keyed strictly by Firebase Auth UID

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: User preferences subcollection under owner profile

/users/{userId}/savedPlaces/{placeId}.description: Saved AliatMaps locations (Casa, Institut, favorites) persisted on the user profile
